review_scope: Read-only code audit of calibration ranks and independent validation; no new full scan or toy cohort executed.
verified: Only original ensemble A defines each masswise inclusive upper-tail map (1+count(A>=q))/1025.
Observed q and every independent-B q use the same frozen A map; B is not used to fit the map or Sidak effective count.
A leave-one-out inclusive rank equals count(A>=q_i)/1024 including self, matching add-one ranks after removing self; ties are counted correctly.
The fixed A-only Sidak fit uses predeclared alpha thresholds and the stated log-survival least-squares formula; it is explicitly approximate.
Independent B uses seed namespace2 versus original A namespace1, preserves complete campaign draws across masses, and runs the unchanged joint likelihood.
The independent global tail compares each B minimum local rank with the observed minimum using <=; Clopper-Pearson intervals are correct conditional on fixed A and source.
The raw-maximum A+B comparison uses the original raw statistic and is kept separate from the locally calibrated min-p construction.
No new signal parameter, dataset choice maximization, or summing of local significances is introduced by the calibration analysis.
Validation independently recomputes inclusive ranks with direct comparisons, the A-only Sidak fit with rankdata, B draw hashes, and selected profile replays.

nonblocking_inference_notes.note: These are pointwise binomial intervals computed at the displayed mass. That displayed local minimum is selected using A-based ranks, so do not describe these local-A intervals as simultaneous or selection-adjusted 95percent coverage. The primary independent-B interval remains valid conditional on fixed A and the observed threshold.

The fixed A-only dependency is established by code and frozen protocol; a boolean named sidak_fitted_before_B_evaluation is not by itself proof of wall-clock execution order. Preserve the frozen fit/protocol record. No numerical change is needed.
